defect.summary: scripts/codex_reviewer_batch.py validate_invocation_evidence re-evaluated the dispatch guard snapshot after each reviewer wave without passing the invocation's recorded model_provider_profile (or legacy transport flag). Under the v6 capacity plan, whose reviewer configuration carries a model provider profile, the recheck failed for every receipt with 'reviewer dispatch guard capacity model provider profile drifted' and the driver refused. The dispatch-time guard evaluation and the batch preflight both passed the profile; the reviewer ran and every wave-1 ruling was written.
defect.classification: validation-only code defect; no measurement semantics, prompts, models, budgets, seeds, or analysis pins involved; not an environmental interruption
defect.reproduction: offline recheck of the failing receipt: without the profile the guard evaluator returns error 'capacity model provider profile drifted'; with the profile it returns verified true and evidence identical to the recorded dispatch-time evidence
defect.fix: validate_invocation_evidence now passes the invocation's recorded transport identity (model_provider_profile or openai_provider_supports_websockets, mutually exclusive) into the recheck
defect.why_not_caught: the capacity preflight carries no dispatch guard, so the recheck path never ran live under a profile-bearing plan, and the provenance fixture's plan carried neither a profile nor the legacy flag
